title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Discounts
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: A bidder submits a price of $100,000 but includes a '2% / 10 days, Net 30' prompt payment discount. Unless the solicitation specifically states otherwise, how is this discount evaluated when determining the lowest bidder?
options: The discount is ignored for evaluation purposes, and the bid is evaluated at $100,000
The bid is deemed non-responsive for offering conditional pricing
The discount is converted into bonus technical points
questions.explain: Standard public procurement practice mandates that prompt payment discounts are NOT considered in determining the low bid because the agency cannot guarantee its accounts payable department will process the invoice within 10 days. The gross amount is evaluated.
